# `company.shipment_billings`

Immutable: an invoice line that billed shipped units, live while that invoice is posted and its current revision carries the line.

Database: `company`.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this billing. |
